notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 regional Auto Provide response surface. The source uses only standard RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador services plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the Auto Provide FOM, object class, attribute, dimensional name, endpoint, provider configuration, and callback model. It verifies one overlapping source and subscriber region, provider-owned registration and discovery, one grouped provideAttributeValueUpdate callback with an empty request tag, a response issued from that callback through updateAttributeValues, and one ordinary reflected value carrying the response tag, reliable transportation, producer, and source-region designator metadata. It does not depend on private headers, registries, provider names, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador regional object publication, registration, subscription, Auto Provide, region, and update services with FederateAmbassador discovery, provideAttributeValueUpdate, and reflectAttributeValues callbacks
